verdicts.reason: Quote states the 50 MHz timing requirement; sign-off only, so check=none is right.
Quote requires RTL to follow the coding rules; a lint/review item, check=none.
Synthesizable is one clause of the quote; split from the others, MUST, not simulation-checkable.
Single clock i_clk, no clock gating, no latches is stated by the quote; structural, check=none.
Quote says shall not rely on initial values; MUST_NOT is correct, structural.
Async reset of output/state flops to the section 5 values is stated. It can be exercised by asserting reset and checked on outputs, so both is acceptable.
Quote requires every output to be driven directly from a flip-flop; structural, so check=none.
Verilator lint-clean compile and simulation is stated; a tool-flow check, check=none.
The quote uses 'should' for the storage bound, so SHOULD is right; area item, check=none.
